Row-wise asymptotic covariance block of transition probabilities

Source: R/03_mat_gamma.R
lambda_block.Rd

Compute the \(m \times m\) block $$\Gamma_i = \mathrm{diag}(p_{i\bullet}) - p_{i\bullet} p_{i\bullet}^\top$$ corresponding to a single row \(p_{i\bullet}\) of a Markov chain transition matrix \(P\), where \(p_{i\bullet}\) denotes the row vector of transition probabilities from state \(i\).

Usage

lambda_block(p)

Arguments

p

Numeric probability row vector \(p_{i\bullet}\). Should be non-negative and sum to 1 (row of a row-stochastic transition matrix).

Value

A numeric matrix of dimension \(m \times m\), where \(m = \mathrm{length}(p)\).
